sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: Later tonight, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天晚些时候，美国

sentences.en: government will find itself in yet another shutdown.
sentences.zh: 政府将发现自己又一次陷入政府关门。

sentences.en: This time of only one agency, the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 这一次只涉及一个机构，即国土安全部。

sentences.en: Today, congressional reporter Michael Gold on why Democrats are once again picking a fight over funding with the president.
sentences.zh: 今天，国会记者迈克尔·戈德将探讨为什么民主党人再次就拨款问题与总统争斗。

sentences.en: It's Friday, February 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月13日，星期五。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you for making time for us on a busy day where I know we just grabbed you inside the U.S.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你在百忙之中抽出时间接受我们的采访，我知道我们刚刚在美利坚合众国

sentences.en: Capitol.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦里找到你。

sentences.en: Yeah, a lot happening here on the Hill today, I would say.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想说今天在国会山这里发生了许多事情。

sentences.en: Well, appreciate you making time for us.
sentences.zh: 好的，感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: As of this moment, at around 3.45 p.m.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，大约在下午3点45分

sentences.en: on Thursday afternoon, it sure looks like we are headed for another government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，情况看起来我们确实将迎来另一次政府关门。

sentences.en: But this one has a very unique twist to it.
sentences.zh: 但这一次有一个非常独特的转折。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: At this point, it looks like at 12.01 a.m.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，在凌晨12点01分

sentences.en: on Saturday morning, the Department of Homeland Security is going to shut down.
sentences.zh: 周六早晨，国土安全部将要关门。

sentences.en: And it's the only government department that we expect will shut down this time.
sentences.zh: 这是我们预计这次唯一会关门的政府部门。

sentences.en: A single agency shutdown.
sentences.zh: 单一机构关门。

sentences.en: A one agency shutdown, and that department is about 4% of U.S.
sentences.zh: 一个机构关门，而那个部门大约占美国

sentences.en: government spending.
sentences.zh: 政府支出的4%。

sentences.en: So if you think about the shutdown we had last year as a full government shutdown and the
sentences.zh: 所以如果你把我们去年的关门看作是全面政府关门，以及

sentences.en: brief one we had earlier this month as a partial government shutdown, this is a very fractional government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我们本月早些时候短暂的关门作为部分政府关门，这是一次非常局部的政府关门。

sentences.en: A fractional government shutdown, right.
sentences.zh: 局部的政府关门，没错。

sentences.en: And as you're hinting at, government shutdowns have become the norm.
sentences.zh: 正如你所暗示的，政府关门已经成了常态。

sentences.en: But even within that weird new norm, this one is quite unique.
sentences.zh: 但即使在这种怪异的新常态下，这一次也相当独特。

sentences.en: So tell us the story of how we get to a single agency fractional shutdown.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲我们是如何走到单一机构局部关门这一步的。

sentences.en: So for the last few months, Congress has really been working hard to pass all of its funding bills.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的几个月里，国会一直在努力通过其所有的拨款法案。

sentences.en: And this is something that Republicans, when they took control of both the House and
sentences.zh: 这是共和党人在夺取众议院和

sentences.en: Senate, set as a major priority.
sentences.zh: 参议院控制权后，设定的一项主要优先事项。

sentences.en: They wanted to pass funding bills.
sentences.zh: 他们想要通过拨款法案。

sentences.en: They wanted to pass individual funding bills, not one big package, and really hash out policy details for every government department.
sentences.zh: 他们希望通过单独的拨款法案，而不是一个庞大的打包法案，并真正敲定每个政府部门的政策细节。

sentences.en: Right, and the argument was that that creates more transparency if you have multiple bills funding the government versus one vast impenetrable bill.
sentences.zh: 没错，争论的焦点在于，如果你有多项法案来资助政府，而不是一项庞大且让人看不透的法案，这会创造更多透明度。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a lot of members of Congress had complained that they had constantly been stuck voting for these big packages, but they never really got to haggle on the specifics of what went
sentences.zh: 许多国会议员抱怨说，他们一直被迫投票支持这些庞大的打包法案，但他们从来没有真正有机会就这些法案中具体包含的内容进行讨价还价

sentences.en: into those bills.
sentences.zh: 处理那些账单。

sentences.en: And so they've been working for months to find agreements, Republicans and Democrats, occasionally
sentences.zh: 因此，他们几个月来一直在努力达成协议，共和党人和民主党人，有时

sentences.en: the White House, coming together to try to find a way that they could fund the government one department at a time.
sentences.zh: 还有白宫，齐心协力试图找到一种能够逐个部门为政府拨款的方法。

sentences.en: I mean, they were putting together bills that cleared the House and Senate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们一直在起草获得众议院和参议院通过的法案。

sentences.en: They were really working together to try to find compromises on things.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在共同努力，试图在各种事情上达成妥协。

sentences.en: And it seemed like everything was on track until last month, when Renee Good was shot and killed by an immigration agent in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 似乎一切都在按计划进行，直到上个月，蕾妮·古德在明尼阿波利斯被一名移民特工开枪打死。

sentences.en: And that's when Democrats realize that they're on the verge of passing a bill to fund the Department of Homeland Security, which oversees ICE and the Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，民主党人意识到他们即将通过一项法案，为监督移民及海关执法局和边境巡逻队的国土安全部提供资金。

sentences.en: And so Democrats start to talk about how they can get serious changes to that bill that would
sentences.zh: 于是民主党人开始讨论如何对该法案进行重大修改，从而

sentences.en: impose some restrictions on the federal immigration operations and the deportation crackdown.
sentences.zh: 对联邦移民行动和驱逐打击施加一些限制。

sentences.en: And they go back to the negotiating table with the White House and with Republicans, and they
sentences.zh: 他们回到与白宫和共和党人的谈判桌前，并且

sentences.en: come up with a kind of compromise bill to fund the Department of Homeland Security that
sentences.zh: 提出了一种为国土安全部提供资金的妥协法案，

sentences.en: includes things like $20 million for body cameras and requirements that officers get enhanced training about use of force and de-escalation techniques.
sentences.zh: 其中包括诸如2000万美元用于随身执法记录仪，以及要求官员接受关于武力使用和降级技术的强化培训等内容。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So Democrats extract some changes to the way that immigration officials are going to be operating in places like Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人对移民官员在明尼阿波利斯等地运作的方式做了一些改变。

sentences.en: They seem modest, but they're there.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来很温和，但确实存在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They know they didn't get everything they wanted, but they feel like this is a pretty good compromise.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己没有得到想要的一切，但他们觉得这是一个相当不错的妥协。

sentences.en: They're very committed to going through the regular funding process.
sentences.zh: 他们非常致力于走正常的拨款程序。

sentences.en: And they say, this is as good as we can get, and it's better to have some restrictions than no restrictions.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这是我们能得到的最好的结果，而且有总比没有限制强。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And that bill is making its way through Congress and hasn't yet cleared the Senate when federal immigration agents kill Alex Petty in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 该法案正在国会推进，尚未在参议院获得通过，这时联邦移民特工在明尼苏达州杀害了亚历克斯·佩蒂。

sentences.en: And at that moment, the politics of this issue really changed for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，这个问题的政治格局对民主党人来说真的变了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because suddenly, these immigration officials have killed two American citizens in what clearly has emerged as a problematic pattern that everyone in the country can see for
sentences.zh: 因为突然之间，这些移民官员杀害了两名美国公民，这明显演变成了一种每个人都能亲眼看出的

sentences.en: themselves.
sentences.zh: 问题模式。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And the video of Alex Petty's shooting spreads very quickly and outrages Democrats.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·佩蒂被枪杀的视频传播得非常快，并激怒了民主党人。

sentences.en: And the party comes out almost unanimously to say that they will not back any new funding for ICE or other immigration agencies unless they can get serious new restrictions that
sentences.zh: 该党几乎一致表态，称他们不会支持对移民及海关执法局或其他移民机构的任何新拨款，除非他们能获得严肃的新限制，

sentences.en: prevent anything like this from happening to an American citizen ever again.
sentences.zh: 以防止任何类似事件再次发生在一个美国公民身上。

sentences.en: So after Alex Petty's death, what was a good enough compromise before is no longer good enough.
sentences.zh: 所以在亚历克斯·佩蒂死后，以前足够好的妥协现在已经不够好了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: ICE and CBP have gotten out of control.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局和海关与边境保护局已经失控了。

sentences.en: We have seen with our own eyes how citizens and peaceful protesters...
sentences.zh: 我们亲眼看到公民和平民抗议者……

sentences.en: And you start to see striking statements from people like Senator Patty Murray, who is the top Democrat on the committee that negotiates funding bills and who had said that she was
sentences.zh: 你可以看到像参议员帕蒂·穆雷这样的人发表了引人注目的声明，她是负责谈判拨款法案的委员会的最高民主党人，她曾表示自己

sentences.en: going to support this bill that she had helped negotiate.
sentences.zh: 将支持她协助谈判的这项法案。

sentences.en: But as soon as the Petty shooting happens, she says, we need to go further and we need to do more.
sentences.zh: 但佩蒂枪击案一发生，她就表示，我们需要走得更远，我们需要做更多的事情。

sentences.en: The killings of Rene Good and Alex Petty really shock the conscious.
sentences.zh: 蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·佩蒂的遇害确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: They demand action.
sentences.zh: 它们要求采取行动。

sentences.en: They demand accountability and justice.
sentences.zh: 它们要求问责和正义。

sentences.en: Democrats are insisting that happens.
sentences.zh: 民主党人坚决要求实现这一点。

sentences.en: Enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 够了，真的够了。

sentences.en: What ICE is doing outside the law is state-sanctioned thuggery and it must stop.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局在法律之外的所作所为是国家批准的暴行，必须停止。

sentences.en: And you see Chuck Schumer, the Senate Democratic leader, come out and say that he believes that this bill doesn't go far enough.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默站出来表示，他认为这项法案还不够深入。

sentences.en: I don't like shutdowns, but obviously this is important.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢关门，但显然这很重要。

sentences.en: And you see a lot of Democrats who usually oppose shutdowns start to demand new conditions.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到许多通常反对政府关门的民主党人开始要求新的条件。

sentences.en: It's not like we can't pass 96 percent of those budgets right now and then just work on the Homeland Security one, which we need to address.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们现在不能通过96%的预算，然后专门处理国土安全预算，我们需要解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Who say that they can't support a bill, even at the risk of a shutdown, if it doesn't impose serious new restrictions on ICE.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果不能对移民及海关执法局实施严格的新限制，即使冒着关门的风险，他们也无法支持这项法案。

sentences.en: And what are the new restrictions that these Democrats start to demand in order to ever agree to fund the Department of Homeland Security?
sentences.zh: 为了同意为国土安全部提供资金，这些民主党人开始要求哪些新限制？

sentences.en: So Democrats have a number of demands that they're making, but chief among them is a requirement
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人提出了许多要求，但其中最重要的是要求

sentences.en: that federal immigration officers visibly show their identification and that they can't be allowed to use masks to hide their identities from the public.
sentences.zh: 联邦移民官员明显展示他们的身份证明，并且不允许他们使用面具向公众隐瞒身份。

sentences.en: And both of those efforts would seem to very much be pointed at accountability, transparency.
sentences.zh: 这两项努力似乎都非常指向问责制和透明度。

sentences.en: An agent's face is visible.
sentences.zh: 特工的脸是可见的。

sentences.en: An agent's name is visible.
sentences.zh: 特工的名字是可见的。

sentences.en: So that's what they're really pushing for.
sentences.zh: 所以这才是他们真正力推的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're arguing that if you make officers be more public about their identities, it might have an impact on their conduct and make them think about how they're interacting with
sentences.zh: 他们认为，如果你让官员在身份上更加公开，可能会对他们的行为产生影响，让他们在与

sentences.en: members of the public.
sentences.zh: 公众互动时有所顾忌。

sentences.en: And this is something that Democrats have wanted throughout Trump's second term.
sentences.zh: 这是民主党人在特朗普整个第二任期内一直想要的。

sentences.en: They have been complaining about this.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在抱怨这一点。

sentences.en: They've argued that it makes ICE equivalent to a secret police force.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这使得移民及海关执法局等同于秘密警察部队。

sentences.en: And now they see this as an opportunity to really demand some changes here.
sentences.zh: 现在他们认为这是一个真正要求在这里做出改变的机会。

sentences.en: And how does the administration respond to that demand?
sentences.zh: 行政当局对这个要求作何回应？

sentences.en: Republicans and the White House have pretty roundly rejected that as a nonstarter.
sentences.zh: 共和党人和白宫相当严词地拒绝了这一点，认为这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: So they say that ICE agents need to be able to protect their identities from the public because they're at risk of being doxxed or otherwise harassed.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说移民及海关执法局特工需要能够向公众保护他们的身份，因为他们面临被公开个人隐私或受到其他骚扰的风险。

sentences.en: And they say that ICE agents are facing an unprecedented rise in threats and that this is how they're
sentences.zh: 他们说移民及海关执法局特工正面临前所未有的威胁上升，这就是他们保护自己的方式，通过隐藏身份，通过向那些心怀恶意的人隐瞒面孔。

sentences.en: protecting themselves, by hiding their identities, by shielding their faces from people who mean them harm.
sentences.zh: 所以双方都固守各自的立场，这些谈判陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: So both sides are entrenched in their positions and these negotiations are at an impasse.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了本周，为国土安全部提供资金的时间已经不多了。

sentences.en: And that brings us to this week, where the clock is ticking to fund the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 莱恩斯先生，你认为自己是一个有宗教信仰的人吗？

sentences.en: Mr. Lyons, do you consider yourself a religious man?
sentences.zh: 是的，女士。

sentences.en: Yes, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你认为手上沾了这么多血，审判日对你来说会是什么样的？

sentences.en: OK, well, how do you think Judgment Day will work for you with so much blood on your hands?
sentences.zh: 我不打算回答这个问题。

sentences.en: I'm not going to entertain that question.
sentences.zh: 民主党人正利用每一个可用的机会来强调他们认为移民系统有多么严重缺陷，以及他们希望对移民及海关执法局和边境巡逻队做出的改变。

sentences.en: And Democrats are using every available opportunity to highlight just how flawed they think the immigration system is and the changes they want to see to ICE and the Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 这发生在他们严厉质问移民及海关执法局和边境保护局负责人的听证会上。

sentences.en: And this comes at hearings where they grill the heads of ICE and Border Protection.
sentences.zh: 莱恩斯先生，你会因为被总统和他的领导层称为国内恐怖分子，而向蕾妮·古德的家人道歉吗？

sentences.en: Mr. Lyons, will you apologize to the family of Renee Goode for being called a domestic terrorist by the president and his leadership?
sentences.zh: 不，先生。

sentences.en: No, sir.
sentences.zh: 为什么不？

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 有一场关于帕姆·邦迪的听证会。

sentences.en: There's a hearing with Pam Bondi.
sentences.zh: 当他们杀害佩蒂先生和古德女士时，那是一次处决。

sentences.en: When they killed Mr. Pretty and Ms. Goode, that was an execution.
sentences.zh: 而你没有调查它。

sentences.en: And you did not investigate it.
sentences.zh: 民主党人借此机会就克里斯蒂·诺姆对她进行严厉质问，并表达对他们政策的反对。

sentences.en: Where Democrats use that as an opportunity to grill her about Kristi Noem and voice objections to their policies.
sentences.zh: 他们被处决了，就像克里斯蒂·诺姆处决她的狗一样。

sentences.en: They were executed like Kristi Noem executed her dog.
sentences.zh: 那是错的。

sentences.en: And that was wrong.
sentences.zh: 你们应该调查那些人，你们应该调查……

sentences.en: And you should investigate those people and you should investigate...
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这场辩论正在众议院和参议院大厅里展开。

sentences.en: And all the while, this debate is playing out on the House floor and on the Senate floor.
sentences.zh: 鉴于每个人在这些问题上变得多么顽固，是否能达成协议确实是一个问题。

sentences.en: And there's a real question of whether a deal can even be made, given how hardened everyone has become on these issues.
sentences.zh: 我认为这把我们带到了周四下午，这场几乎板上钉钉的政府关门，以及这样一个现实：

sentences.en: Which I think brings us to Thursday afternoon and this all-but-assured shutdown and the reality
sentences.zh: 国会民主党人在这一点上不再仅仅是为了预算以及国土安全部如何获得资金而挑起争端。
